resources.string:
Watching requires an internet connection. Yandex provides ads and receives your IP address and technical device data. Personalization, location tracking and app ad analytics reporting are disabled.

Diary text, search queries, mood and tags are not attached to ad requests. Your diary keeps working offline.

The separate ad process ends after closing the ad or moving it to the background. Ad provider privacy policy: yandex.ru/legal/confidential.
Your diary stays on this device. You can cancel at any time.
The ad could not be shown. Your diary remains available. Returning to your entries.
